name: User Registered
description: Emitted when a new user completes registration and email verification is pending

name: User Logged In
description: Emitted when a user successfully authenticates and creates a session

name: Content Published
payload: { contentId, creatorId, title, tierId, isPPV, timestamp }
description: Emitted when content processing completes and content becomes visible to subscribers

name: Content Deleted
description: Emitted when content is soft or hard deleted, triggers storage cleanup

name: Content Viewed
description: Emitted when a user views content, used for analytics tracking

name: Payment Completed
payload: { paymentId, userId, creatorId, amount, type, feeAmount, netAmount, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a crypto payment transaction is successfully verified on-chain

name: Payment Failed
description: Emitted when a payment attempt fails, triggers notification to user

name: Subscription Created
payload: { subscriptionId, fanId, creatorId, tierId, amount, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a fan successfully subscribes to a creator's tier

name: Subscription Cancelled
payload: { subscriptionId, fanId, creatorId, tierId, cancelledAt, effectiveEnd }
description: Emitted when a fan cancels a subscription, access continues until period end

name: Subscription Expired
description: Emitted when a subscription reaches its end date without renewal

name: Tip Received
payload: { paymentId, fanId, creatorId, amount, message, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a fan sends a tip to a creator, includes optional message

name: Payout Initiated
description: Emitted when a creator payout process is started

name: Payout Completed
description: Emitted when a creator payout is successfully processed

name: Message Sent
payload: { messageId, conversationId, senderId, recipientId, messageType, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a message is sent and stored, triggers real-time delivery and notification

name: Message Read
description: Emitted when a recipient reads a message, updates read receipt status

name: Notification Sent
description: Emitted when a notification is delivered to a user via any channel

name: Admin Action
payload: { actionId, adminId, actionType, targetType, targetId, details, timestamp }
description: Emitted when an admin performs a moderation or management action, logged for audit

name: Contest Created
payload: { contestId, creatorId, title, prize, entryFee, startDate, endDate, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a creator publishes a new contest

name: Contest Ended
description: Emitted when a contest reaches its end date and judging begins

name: Contest Winner Selected
payload: { contestId, winnerId, entryId, place, prize, selectedAt }
description: Emitted when a contest winner is selected and prize is awarded

name: Crypto Wallet Verified
description: Emitted when a user's Solana wallet is cryptographically verified

name: Verification Doc Uploaded
description: Emitted when a creator submits verification documents for review

name: Verification Approved
description: Emitted when an admin approves a creator's verification documents

name: Verification Rejected
description: Emitted when an admin rejects a creator's verification documents with reason

name: Enclave Application Submitted
description: Emitted when a fan submits an enclave membership application

name: Referral Bonus Awarded
payload: { bonusId, referrerId, refereeId, amount, sourcePaymentId, timestamp }
description: Emitted when a referral bonus is calculated and credited to the referrer's account
